scope.description: Whole pyproj application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: CRS representation, coordinate/vertical transformations, geodesics, grids, projections and operation/database discovery.

coverage.rationale: One geodesic stationing task uses little of the CRS/projection/transformation library.

scope.description: Continuous WGS84 ellipsoidal route stationing with labelled leg/station tables and GeoJSON.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Route spacing, endpoint policy and physical distances express survey intent without geodesic loop/interpolation code.

limitations: WGS84 geographic routes in the declared latitude/length domain only; no antimeridian, general CRS transforms, vertical datums or grid selection.
